correctness.rationale: The exact face-set identity N(G∪_v H)=N(G)∪N(H)∪Δ_{N_G(v)∪N_H(v)} has intersection two disjoint faces. The homotopy pushout is an added 1-cell between two points of connected N(G)∨N(H), giving exactly one extra S1. Bridge attachments collapse without altering N. Induction over the block-cut tree determines the full wedge. The long exact sequence of pairs gives the canonical high-degree integral clique-boundary generators and their natural permutation signs. The standalone verifier constructs all face sets and checks 4792 small labeled cases, 150 larger cases, 99 gluing identities, 100 tree-line-graph cases, and 72 automorphisms. Finite computations are supporting only; the all-order proof is combinatorial/topological.

originality.rationale: Compared the exact homotopy statement, cut-vertex gluing, signed integral generator theorem and tree-line-graph specialization against focused research-index results and four relevant primary manuscripts. value.rationale: Block graphs and line graphs of trees are natural infinite graph families with a structural clique-tree decomposition; their neighborhood complexes may exhibit arbitrarily high, mixed-dimensional spheres. The theorem gives the entire homotopy type from a multiset of block sizes and explains independence from the attachment shape, unlike an arbitrary numeric census. Canonical signed automorphism modules extend the result beyond Betti-number counting and motivate equivariant applications.
